15. 给零件镀镍时，在 $2$ 小时内通过电解槽的电流为 $25$ 安培。
镍的电化当量为 $3\times10^{-7}$ 千克/库仑，它的密度为 $8.9\times10^3$ 千克/米$^3$。
如果零件的面积为 $0.2$ 米$^2$，则镍层的厚度是多少？

en.text:
15. During $2$ hours of nickel-plating a part, the current through the electrolytic cell is $25$ amperes.
The electrochemical equivalent of nickel is $3\times10^{-7}$ kilograms per coulomb, and its density is $8.9\times10^3$ kilograms per meter$^3$.
If the area of the part is $0.2$ meter$^2$, what is the thickness of the nickel layer?
